title: Chapter 483
text:
"Huff, huff …"

Sylvia ran through the ruins, panting. She dodged the enemies everywhere. This level of battle was still too early for her. There was almost nothing she could do. Fu Ding was stalling for time. She didn't dare to waste the opportunity created by Fu Ding.

After running for a long time, her lungs were burning. Sylvia stopped and held her knees as she panted.

Rumble —

Suddenly, an earth-shattering gust of wind blew over, and the wind pressure from Anur grew stronger and stronger. Sylvia had a look of fear on her face. With such a large area, there was no way she could escape. She stood there in a daze and looked up, watching as the gust of wind rapidly approached.

At this moment, a Amphiptere mecha rushed out. The chest armor split open and swallowed Sylvia whole. The next moment, the storm swept past. This mecha was sent flying along with countless bricks and steel. It fell hundreds of meters away.

Sylvia hid inside the mecha. She was only dizzy from the impact but was fine. She had escaped death. She shouted in surprise, "Philip?!"

"Master asked me to protect you and hide. Hum … he said the storm is expanding. Hum …"

She instinctively looked up at the sky. Using the vision of the mecha, she saw that a tornado had formed in the sky inside the protective shield. Countless things were being sucked into this whirlpool and spun in the sky. The tornado was still expanding. Through the flying debris, she could see Anur flying in a clockwise direction. He was like a flash of light, stirring the air like a turbine.

The protective shield was only so big. Anur let go of his hands and prepared to create a tornado large enough to fill up the inside of the protective shield. He could attack indiscriminately. In a sealed area, his storm could reach the level of destruction faster.

In the sky.

Anur was too fast. Han Xiao and Nagojin couldn't touch him at all. He was flying in circles at his own speed. The two of them couldn't do anything about it.

"If we let him continue like this, when the storm is fully formed, everything inside the shield will be crushed. Even his subordinates won't be spared. Does he want to abandon his subordinates?"

Nagojin's tone was heavy. He was experienced and could already see the result. They couldn't keep up with the other party's speed and couldn't stop Anur at all. If the Noriose guardians watching from afar could help, they might be able to stop Anur, but the guardians didn't seem to want to help.

The two sides fighting on the ground simultaneously moved away from the center, but there were still quite a few people who were swept up, crushed into bloody bits by the devastating wind pressure. Quite a few of Han Xiao's machines were also caught in the storm. The mechanical beasts struggled futilely in the storm, and the bases of the turrets that were inserted into the ground were uprooted, tossing and turning in the violent winds.

Looking from the outside of the protective shield, an iron-gray vortex made of countless debris was rapidly expanding. The inner circle of the protective shield was occasionally scraped by the rotating debris, and electric sparks kept bursting out. It was like a washing machine.

This scene was as if the world was spinning!

In the storm, Han Xiao's armor had long been shattered, and the Void Dragon mechanical suit was also covered in wounds. He only managed to stabilize himself after pouring all his energy into the mechanical wings and thrusters. Seeing that the situation was not good, he knew that if he didn't stop Anur, everyone else would be finished.

A Grade A Super at full power was too strong. Han Xiao had even used [Life Return] once. He could not help but be even more certain of one thing. Luckily, he had used the Mission Completion Card to advance his Promotion. Otherwise, he would have definitely been defeated.

He yearned for such strength. Han Xiao was currently level 116, and he still had more than two hundred million experience left on his interface. If not for the fact that he had already advanced, he would probably have to use [Life Return] once or twice more in this battle. Currently, most of his current methods would not be effective. After all, Dark-star was attacking, and he did not have much time to prepare. Furthermore, after his Promotion, Han Xiao did not have much free time to build new machines.

Luckily, I made a copy of Ames' Character Summon Card. Otherwise, I would have to run. Now, I have a trump card that can turn the situation around.

Han Xiaoxin made up his mind and said loudly to Nagojin in the communication channel, "What's your strongest attack?"

"What do you mean?" Nagojin was confused.

"I have a way to make Anur stop. It should be able to restrict him for about ten seconds. During that time, he won't be able to move or use his abilities. This is the only chance to heavily injure him," Han Xiao said with a deep voice.

The situation was changing rapidly, and it was very disadvantageous. However, he still maintained his calm. Although he had explosive means, a Grade A Super had extremely high resistance. Even if Anur was not known for his defense, just his own attack alone would not be enough to destroy the enemy's combat ability. He had already tested it on Ashes once.

Only the Grade A Naga 'Muscle Bully' Kim could deal fatal damage to him. Only then would he not waste this precious Dragon Emperor Character Summon Card!

"Ten seconds? Can you really control Anur? "Nagojin could not believe it and thought that he had heard wrongly.

Ten seconds was not something that could be described as an 'opportunity' for people of their level. It was the difference between life and death!

This Black Star was only a Grade B, so how could he possibly restrict a Calamity Grade for ten seconds?

"Just believe in me."

Han Xiao's tone was deep. Anur was an Esper, and his main attribute was speed. No matter what, his Strength could not possibly exceed 1,800 points!

"… Okay!"

Nagojin took a deep breath. Black Star was able to defeat Ashes, and he had never disappointed him before. Maybe he really could do it. He decided to believe in him this time and immediately started to gather energy. All the cells in his body released a powerful Pugilist flame. It was like a golden flame that could not be extinguished by the wind. Instead, it became stronger and stronger, and his aura continued to rise.

He did not even need ten seconds. In fact, he only needed to stop Anur for one second, and that would be enough for him. His strongest attack was a storm of attacks, and he was only worried that he would not be able to hit the enemy.

Han Xiao focused his vision and stared at Wind Demon, who was moving at high speed in the wind. He pointed his hand at Wind Demon from afar with a sharp gaze.

Success or failure depended on this!

…

"What is he trying to do?"

Anur also noticed Han Xiao's actions. He could still see all the details clearly in the storm.

He did not understand Han Xiao's actions, but the fact that Han Xiao was able to survive until now in the area where the storm was the strongest surprised Anur. Compared to the standards of a Grade B Super, Han Xiao's vitality was a little too strong.

However, he should be reaching his limit soon. Anur turned around and looked at the edge of the battlefield. The Guardian had started to move, moving toward Black Star. It seemed that it also felt that Black Star was in danger and wanted to take him away. Anur immediately understood the Noriose Financial Group's intention.

"You want to save Black Star from my hands? You don't want to anger Ames, right? Humph, you wish."

Anur sneered and controlled a gust of wind to attack the Guardian that was rushing over, slowing down the Guardian's footsteps. Then, he charged forward with a terrifying wind pressure cannon that was powerful enough to blast a crater out of the ground, attacking Han Xiao.

Anur was determined to get rid of him here!

"Sh * t!" The Guardian was shocked. The upper echelons had asked him to intervene in an emergency to prevent the high-level combatants of both sides from being killed. He originally wanted to take Black Star away from the battlefield first, but he did not expect Anur to attack him. He was going to kill Black Star even at the risk of angering the Guardian.

At this moment …

A terrifying energy wave suddenly erupted from Han Xiao's body, causing everyone's face to change color!

It was as if the space had frozen.

Hum!

The shadow of a woman appeared behind Han Xiao and extended her hand toward the approaching Anur.

"That's … Dragon Emperor Ames!"

Nagakin, Anur, and the Guardian all had looks of shock on their faces!

…
